source_review: Release tag peels to exactly current public source. Full actual runtime catalog supplies identical revision evidence for release/current. No source/root lock edits. Twenty-four functions include four generated typed fit names missed by static extraction; six parameterless functions also appear as same-name tables and count once. No views or COPY formats. Fit/search can write the local model registry; drop_model deletes from it and remains in denominator. california_housing may fetch public dataset on execution; DESCRIBE bound its schema without scanning it. No authenticated objects.
launcher: Release has no executable assets/console script and setuptools omits root entry point. Worker-specific companion checks tag/full SHA, atomically caches verified source, syncs release uv.lock with --frozen --no-dev --no-install-project and execs the unchanged root script under Python3.13. No dependency overrides or worker build.
behavior_notes: Cross-validation integer regression folds are unshuffled KFold on input row order.
For direct regression fit, registry train_score is in-sample R squared. Search stores best CV score in the same field; notebook uses explicit leaderboard scores.
Permutation scorer is negative root mean squared error; positive score drop means RMSE increase.
Partial dependence uses sklearn average method and actual returned grid; it does not imply a causal effect.
